blocks.content:
• CAG is NOT a part of Parliament.
• CAG does NOT control money — only audits it.
• Removal is similar to a Supreme Court judge.
• Salary is equal to a Supreme Court judge.
CAG does NOT control money — only audits it.

items: Common Trap: Questions may falsely claim CAG controls the release of money; CAG ONLY audits it.
Do not confuse CAG with parliamentary office; CAG is NOT a part of Parliament.
Remember that both removal procedure and salary for CAG are identical/similar to a Supreme Court judge.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The CAG is not a part of Parliament.
The CAG does not control public funds; its function is limited strictly to auditing.
The removal process of the CAG is similar to that of a Supreme Court judge.
The CAG receives a salary equal to that of a Supreme Court judge.
